county.definition:
n. (United Kingdom) a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government
n. (United States) the largest administrative district within a state

county agent.translation: n. 负责农业技术推广及乡村教育的官员

county clerk.translation: （美国负责选举及房产登记等的）县政官员

county courthouse.translation: [网络] 县法院；县法庭；法院大楼

county fair.translation: 县集市, 县农产品交易会

county palatine.translation: [法] 特权领, 享有王权的伯爵的领地

county sessions.translation: [法] 郡高等法院开庭期, 县法院开庭期

countywide.definition: s. occurring or extending throughout a county
countywide.translation: 遍及全郡（或县）的；全郡（或县）的
